reflectionQuestion: When you miss someone, what helps you remember the good times you had together?
title: The Golden Leaf
theme: sadness, loss, feeling hurt but finding a small comfort
reflectionText:
Tomas lost someone he loved very much. The house felt empty and the silence felt loud. But a golden leaf landed right where he needed it, like the world was whispering that love doesn't disappear — it just gets quieter.

When we lose someone we care about, the sadness shows us how big our love really was.
